crossRefs.note: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translations.bsb: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
translations.kjv: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translations.asv: then beware lest thou forget Jehovah, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
